title: Ukraine’s drones knock out AI data center belonging to "Russia’s Google"
script:
Ukrainian drones just destroyed a Yandex data center holding critical supercomputers.
The strike knocked out hardware specifically used for training Yandex GPT models.
Yandex operates the dominant search engine in Russia and is often called Russia's Google.
This single facility held two of the company's three main AI supercomputers.
The facility loss severely hampers domestic computing power available for major language models.
Will this infrastructure loss permanently delay Russian AI independence?
